pathforge_fit_adaptation: Transforms the outside need for fast Instagram captions into an offline inspection board where creators compare tone, CTA strength, hashtag bucket choices, and emoji density before posting. The artifact is a self-contained local HTML board with topic/audience/tone inputs, generated editable caption cards, CTA warnings, hashtag checklist, copy/export controls, and 390px mobile-safe layout.

steps.prompt_exact: Can you make me a phone-friendly one-file browser board for planning Instagram captions where I can enter a post topic, audience, and tone, compare caption cards by CTA strength, hashtag mix, and emoji density, then copy or export the best option before I post?
steps.response_exact:
This one-file planning board is self-contained and fully responsive for mobile use. It allows you to enter your post details, generate and compare three distinct caption strategies side-by-side (or stacked on mobile), edit them live, and copy them directly to your clipboard.

[Interactive visual displayed in Gemini iframe]
Caption Strategy Planner
Table columns: Strategy, Draft (Editable), Copy
Rows shown: Direct & Educational — CTA: High HT: Targeted Emoji: Low; Story-Driven — CTA: Medium HT: Mixed Emoji: High; Punchy & Short — CTA: Urgent HT: Niche Emoji: Medium
Inputs shown: Topic: 3 Common Financial Planning Mistakes; Audience: Young professionals looking to invest; Tone: Informative; Generate Captions button.
steps.response_summary: Gemini produced a hosted interactive visual/iframe with a short description, but no full source code to save as a production artifact.
steps.notes: Transcript/preview-only step. The visible response and iframe contents were captured as exact source evidence; no mountable artifact file was saved from this step.

steps.prompt_exact: This is useful, but I can only see it as a Gemini visual and I need the actual complete single HTML file so I can save it and open it locally. Please return the full self-contained HTML for the caption board, including the inputs, editable caption cards, CTA warnings, hashtag checklist, and copy/export controls.
steps.response_summary: Gemini returned a Python-wrapped HTML string for instagram_caption_planner.html, plus feature bullets. The extracted HTML was saved as v1, but failed hard gates.
steps.continuation_reason: Prompt 1 only produced a hosted Gemini visual/iframe with no complete source file to save locally.
steps.notes: Preserved as real artifact version v1. Rejected for inline onclick/oninput/onchange handlers and dynamic innerHTML usage.

steps.prompt_exact: The HTML file is close, but it uses inline onclick/oninput/onchange handlers and dynamic innerHTML to build hashtag controls, which would make this fail my local review. Please return the complete HTML file only, not a Python wrapper, and keep the same caption-board workflow while using addEventListener, createElement, textContent, and setAttribute instead of inline handlers, innerHTML, outerHTML, or insertAdjacentHTML.
